title: Lamb Tagine Australian Style
description: A unique twist on traditional German cuisine, this dish combines tender lamb with the sweetness of Australian ingredients. Serve with a side of crusty bread for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to brown.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tagine spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried apricots and red wine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Season the lamb with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the lamb and sauce over couscous or rice.
